Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. The timing when this card is played into the battle area and the timing when a card is removed from your security stack are the same, so the [All Turns] effect can trigger and activate.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [All Turns] effect to give 1 of my opponent's Digimon  when this card is played by [BT13-012 GeoGreymon]'s [When Digivolving] effect?

Effect: When effects trash this card from the security stack, give 1 of your opponent's Digimon ＜Security A. -1＞ until the end of their turn.
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[All Turns] When effects remove from your security stack, by suspending this Tamer, give 1 of your opponent's Digimon ＜Security A. -1＞ until the end of their turn.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
